Bruno, one minute. How many hours do you sleep?
Six, usually. I always wake up at five thirty for school.
Six is not enough. And do you drink water during practice?
Sometimes. I often forget it, because I am always busy.
Busy is not a reason. A tired body never plays well. What about the gym?
I go often, but I sometimes play video games until late. That is my problem.
Good. You know your problem. Change one habit, not five.
OK. I never go to bed after midnight. From today.
I always wake up at five thirty.
I usually drink water in class.
I often go to the gym after school.
I never say I can't. I say not yet.

Hi, it's Tyler. My coach asks us about our habits every month, so here are mine. I always wake up at six thirty, even on the weekend. I usually have a big breakfast, but I never eat before practice. I often go to the gym with my brother, maybe three times a week. I sometimes play video games until late, and then I am tired the next day. And I never drink soda in the season. Never. That is the only rule I really follow.

Good morning, group two. Before we start, one minute about water. You often forget this, so listen. Drink water before practice, not only after. A big glass, thirty minutes before. During practice, small drinks, many times. And after practice, drink again, even if you are not thirsty. Your body always needs more water than you think, and a tired body never plays well. That's all. Now, court B, in five minutes.

Bruno always wakes up early on a school day. He usually has a small breakfast at home. He often goes to the gym after school. He sometimes plays video games until late. He never drinks soda before a game.
